fieldValues.title: The default CI checkout defeats any git-history-diffing check
fieldValues.summary: Both validate.yml's AND release-drift.yml's actions/checkout steps had no fetch-depth set, so both defaulted to a shallow depth-1 clone. A check that diffs a file's own commit history (git log -- path) sees only the single tip commit in that mode -- there is never a second revision to compare against, so the check would run, exit 0, and report success without ever performing the comparison it exists to make. This is the same shape of failure the census's own framing warns about: a check that has never been observed to fail is indistinguishable from one that cannot fail, except here the cause is the CI environment rather than the check's own logic.
evidence: .github/workflows/validate.yml's Checkout step used actions/checkout@v4 with no fetch-depth argument prior to srs#649/PR#655, i.e. the actions/checkout default (fetch-depth: 1).
git log --follow --format=%H -- <path> against a depth-1 clone returns exactly one commit hash, regardless of how many revisions the file actually has in the repository's real history.
check-versioning-cell.mjs (srs#649) is the first check in this repository to read git history rather than a live-tree snapshot; no existing check in scripts/checks.json needed this before.

CORRECTED (still on srs#649/PR#655, same session): release-drift.yml ALSO runs scripts/validate-all.mjs internally (check-release-drift.mjs's first step) under its OWN separate checkout ('path: srs'), which likewise had no fetch-depth override. This was missed on the first pass -- validate.yml was fixed, PR #655 pushed, and CI on check-release-drift failed with the allowlist entry reading as stale (0 violations found for value_range.json under the shallow clone). Fixed in the same PR (commit ccb9dd6) once diagnosed.
fieldValues.body: Any future check that needs to compare a file (or record) across commits -- not just the versioning cell's sibling cells (attribution, repository) if their own smallest-honest-check ever turns out to need history rather than a structural shape validation -- must confirm EVERY CI workflow step that runs scripts/validate-all.mjs (there are two: validate.yml's own job, and release-drift.yml's check-release-drift.mjs, which calls validate-all.mjs as its first internal step under a separate checkout) actually fetches enough history, and should say so in its own doc comment the way check-versioning-cell.mjs now does. srs#649 fixed both workflows' checkouts (fetch-depth: 0) in PR #655 -- but only after CI on the first push caught the one this finding's original text had wrongly assumed was out of scope. The corrected lesson: 'grep the workflows for validate-all.mjs, fix every checkout that shows up' is the actual generalizable check, not 'the workflow I already fixed.'
